name: breadcrumb-link-component
title: Breadcrumb: Link Component
description:
Pass a router link to the `render` prop on `<BreadcrumbLink />`. In an app, use `Link` from `@erbium/ui/components/link`, which preloads the route before the click:

```tsx
<BreadcrumbLink render={<Link to="/projects" />}>Projects</BreadcrumbLink>
```

files.content:
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/breadcrumb";

export const BreadcrumbLinkDemo = () => (
  <Breadcrumb>
    <BreadcrumbList>
      <BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbLink render={<a href="#link-component" />}>Home</BreadcrumbLink>
      </BreadcrumbItem>
      <BreadcrumbSeparator />
      <BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbLink render={<a href="#link-component" />}>Components</BreadcrumbLink>
      </BreadcrumbItem>
      <BreadcrumbSeparator />
      <BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbPage>Breadcrumb</BreadcrumbPage>
      </BreadcrumbItem>
    </BreadcrumbList>
  </Breadcrumb>
);
